Writing the replay module first, then wiring storage, preflight, and resource accounting.Implemented a virtual quote series in the five owned files only. No imports, tests, or other writes were run.

**`QuoteReplaySeries`** records logical chunk lengths and per-column value digests (≤65536 rows, no quote Parquet). `finish` writes a bounded replay descriptor, then does one full `AuctionFlowStream` replay against the **original producer** manifest (entire manifest except `source_cpu_components`). Success returns `roundtrip_exact=True` only after that replay. Implementation/runtime pins (`auction_flow_data`, `compact`, `compact_native`, `reconcile`, `auction_flow_arrow`, this module, plus Python/numpy/pyarrow) fail closed on mismatch. A private verifier can check a descriptor before any success flag.

**Storage:** `read_series_tables` dispatches `encoding='raw-source-quote-replay-v1'` and returns; Parquet behavior is unchanged. Consumers must exhaust the generator; the source identity check runs after the last yield.

**Preflight:** optional `quote_storage='parquet'|'replay'` on `measured_unit` and `partition_parity` (default physical). Replay uses `protocol['source_index']` and source-only carry when partitioned. Trade/excluded/native writers are unchanged. Finish receives `measured['source_manifest']` only.

**Accounting:** replay validation CPU is a separate result field and is subtracted from `event_storage_finalization_cpu_seconds`. It is excluded from `parquet_and_roundtrip_cpu_seconds`. Failure CPU-per-byte uses physical Parquet bytes only. Replay CPU is `replayCPU / physical_reader_batches` scaled by `reader_batches_upper`, or a fixed empty-window term; nonzero CPU with zero batches and zero sources is rejected. Descriptor bytes are forecast per source window, not per quote. All-physical projections keep the old rates path. One required finish replay is counted; later rereads stay on the running study stage.

**Tests:** fixture helpers from `test_auction_flow_data`; independent expected values from the original stream plus physical `ParquetSeries`. Covers instrument-order/split ties, empty quiet intervals, continuation after invalidation, tamper/raw trade-size failures, bounds/failure charging, and resource accounting.

Parent still owns review, integration, runner/extension wiring, and registered execution of all nine source units plus all three continuations against immutable benchmark 18.
